description: This PHP source file defines the OAuthClientDao class which provides data access functionalities for OAuthClient entities, including CRUD operations, search, and filtering, within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: OAuthClientDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing OAuthClient entities, providing CRUD operations, search, and counting functionalities in the OAuth module.

methods.name: saveOAuthClient

methods.name: getOAuthClientList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OAuthClient entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getOAuthClientCount
methods.description: Returns the count of OAuthClient entities matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: getOAuthClientQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Creates and configures a QueryBuilderWrapper for OAuthClient entities with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getOAuthClientById
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuthClient entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getOAuthClientByClientId
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuthClient entity by its client ID.

methods.name: deleteOAuthClients
methods.description: Deletes multiple OAuthClient entities specified by their IDs.
